rv.q: My Romantic History is seriously funny, heart rending and hilarious.
It's a well-acted show with plenty going for it, but one that finishes with more promise than payoff.
It’s diverting enough, but the piece is hardly a modern classic.

cn.t: A lively Scottish rom-com with a strong cast starts promisingly but loses momentum as its dual-perspective office romance becomes repetitive and circles back on itself.
